AcceptEarsRequest.description:
The exact EARS-normalized statement the caller reviewed. EARS suggestions are not graph
state, so the server never rediscovers or regenerates one; the text replaces the current
statement through a human-confirm proposal.

AnswerRequest.description:
An answer to a Question (Hotfix 065): `answer` is validated against the persisted
`Question.answer_schema` (every pilot answer schema is a closed JSON object).

supersedes.description: The Accepted ResolutionDecision this answer supersedes.

action.description:
The authoritative workflow class of the exact pending Proposal (Hotfix 076): the one
existing proposal action endpoint that can confirm it.

Assumption.description: A recorded assumption; `default_value` is recorded material, not executable truth.

AssumptionPage.description:
A page of results; `next_cursor` is null on the last page. An item of the page whose
projection failed is in `health` (with its typed error) instead of `items`; corruption
is reported, never hidden, and the remaining items are still returned.

CalculationPage.description: A page of results; `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

CalculationValue.description:
An exact, non-recursive PlumbExpr value (Hotfix 065). Decimal, duration and quantity values
are exact decimal strings and never pass through a binary float.

CreateRoundResponse.description: The composed round of `POST /api/rounds` and the write that assigned it (Hotfix 065).

CrudCell.description:
One CRUD cell. The PSG distinguishes only `reads` and `writes`: `null` in `c`, `u` or `d`
means not distinguishable from current PSG semantics, not false (Hotfix 065).

CursorConflictResponse.description: 409: the cursor was issued for another semantic hash.

DecisionPage.description: A page of results; `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

DesignEvent.description: A design change notification: what changed and at which revision.

version.description: The revision compatibility value associated with the event.

id.description: The Attribute ID (the target of set_attribute_type, _unit and _class).

EntityPage.description: A page of results; `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

family.description: The validation gate/family of the finding (e.g. `I0`, `F1`); not the rule class.

oneOf.description:
The rule class of the active-profile rule whose ID equals `code`; `null` when the code is
not a rule of the active profile (Hotfix 080).

FindingPage.description: A page of results; `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

FindingRuleClass.description:
Where a finding's rule authority comes from (Hotfix 080): the active validation profile's
`RuleMetadata.rule_class` of the rule whose ID equals `Finding.code`.

GateEvaluationState.description:
The evaluation state of a NOW gate on the branch head (H0.11, architecture §33.12):
`current` has a report for the head; `stale` has only reports of earlier heads and cannot be
evaluated now; `not_evaluated` has never been evaluated and cannot be evaluated now. A gate
that is not current carries no rule results.

GateRuleApplicability.description: A rule's applicability; `reason` is the exact server reason when not applicable, else null.

GateRuleApplicabilityState.description: Whether a rule applied to the gate's scope (Hotfix 082).

GateRuleError.description: The evaluator failure of an ERROR rule result.

GateRuleResult.description:
One rule result of a current gate report (Hotfix 082); severities are the exact validation
severity strings (`blocker`, `error`, `warn`, `info`).

GateRuleState.description: The exact result state of one rule in a gate report (Hotfix 082).

GateStateReason.description: The typed failure that keeps a gate from being evaluated on the branch head.

passed.description: The current report's result; false when the gate is not current.

oneOf.description:
Why the gate is not current: the typed failure that prevents its evaluation now; null
exactly when `state` is `current`.

rules.description: The report's rule results, in report order (Hotfix 082).

state.description: Whether this entry is the gate's report current for the branch head (H0.11).

waivers.description: The report's applied governed waivers, in report order (Hotfix 082).

GateSummaryView.description: The summary counts of a gate report.

GateWaiver.description: One governed waiver applied by a gate report.

GlossaryPage.description: A page of results; `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

IntakeReportView.description: The public compatibility projection of an X1.3 intake report (report data only).

conflicts_with.description: Declared conflicts plus surfaced validation conflict findings.

IntakeRequest.description:
A dry-run intake of one complete typed Proposal (Hotfix 065): `payload` is the exact JSON
of a `plumb_patch::Proposal`, `kind` its derived ProposalKind and `evidence` exactly its
sorted unique evidence refs.

ItemHealth.description:
The typed health marker of a collection item whose projection failed (H0.11): the element
ID, the typed error code and message. The item's detail route fails with the same error.

base_revision.description: The branch revision the job captured.

JobStatus.description: Stage job status (X1.5); `stale` is a status, not a flag.

inference_available.description:
Whether this server can run inference (sessions and inference-requiring recipes): false
exactly when the configured provider mode is `null` (H0.11, Fable #355).

ModelDiff.description: Stable element IDs changed between two revisions.

PreconditionFailedResponse.description:
412: the request's If-Match did not name the current branch-head revision. `revision` and
`semantic_hash` are the current branch-head values.

flows.description:
The active `next` topology between the Process's nodes, sorted by `from` then `to`
(Hotfix 079): the flow authority.

lanes.description: Sorted unique performer refs of the Process's nodes (active `performed_by` targets).

nodes.description: The Process's ProcessNodes, sorted by ID (Hotfix 079).

steps.description:
Sorted ProcessNode IDs belonging to the Process; not semantic execution order (use
`flows`).

ProcessFlowView.description: One active canonical `next` relation between two ProcessNodes of the Process (Hotfix 079).

ProcessNodeView.description:
One ProcessNode of a Process with its exact semantic material (Hotfix 079): the payload
fields and the targets of its active `performed_by`, `consumes` and `produces` relations,
each sorted and unique.

consumes_refs.description: Targets of the active `consumes` relations: trigger/event inputs.

performer_refs.description: Targets of the active `performed_by` relations: the swimlane authority.

produces_refs.description: Targets of the active `produces` relations: outcomes/events.

ProcessPage.description: A page of results; `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

ProcessStepRequest.description:
NOW process-step mutations, tagged by `op` (no `branch`; Hotfix 065). `add`, `move` and
`remove` change a strict linear Process and `position` is zero-based among interior steps;
`move_lane` (Hotfix 079) replaces the performers of one human or service task. `reason` is the
optional rationale passed to the shared intake/write path.

ProposalActionRequest.description: A proposal action; `reason` is required at runtime when intake demands one.

ProposalKind.description:
The closed workflow action classification of a Proposal (Hotfix 065); it does not change
materiality or acceptance policy.

Question.description:
The persisted projection of one Accepted PSG Question (Hotfix 065). Generation-time slots
are not persisted and are not part of the contract; `answer_schema` is the typed-answer
authority and `context_refs` are the exact persisted context IDs.

QuestionPage.description:
A page of results; `next_cursor` is null on the last page. An item of the page whose
projection failed is in `health` (with its typed error) instead of `items`; corruption
is reported, never hidden, and the remaining items are still returned.

Readiness.description:
Readiness; `overall` is an uncalibrated, non-authoritative pilot composite. `null` means not
calculated by the current pilot runtime; readiness never influences a gate.

ReadinessSubScores.description: Readiness sub-scores. `null` means not calculated by the current pilot runtime, not zero.

ears_proposal_ref.description:
The ID of that pending S1.2 EARS WorkflowProposal, accepted through the governed
proposal acceptance (R0.6); `null` exactly when `ears_suggestion` is `null`.

ears_suggestion.description:
The normalized statement of the pending S1.2 EARS WorkflowProposal of this Requirement
on the current head (R0.6); `null` when there is none. Paired with `ears_proposal_ref`.

lint_current.description:
Whether a current F1 gate report exists for the branch head (R0.4). When false,
`smells` and `lint_findings` are `[]`, `readiness` is `null` and lint is unavailable.

lint_findings.description:
IDs of the current F1 gate report's findings whose affected refs include this
requirement. Always `[]` when `lint_current` is false.

RequirementPage.description: A page of results; `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

lint_current.description:
Whether a current F1 gate report exists for the branch head (R0.4). When false, lint
results are unavailable (not "no findings").

readiness.description:
Advisory readiness; `null` means not calculated by the current pilot runtime. Always
`null` when `lint_current` is false.

smells.description:
Error-severity lint rule IDs recorded for this requirement by the current F1 gate report
(F1 evaluates Accepted Requirements only). Always `[]` when `lint_current` is false.

rows.description: `null` means not applicable or not analyzable, not empty (Hotfix 065).

outcome.description: The exact RFC 8785 JSON of one DecisionOutputCell.

RulePage.description:
A page of results; `next_cursor` is null on the last page. An item of the page whose
projection failed is in `health` (with its typed error) instead of `items`; corruption
is reported, never hidden, and the remaining items are still returned.

RuleViewKind.description: Whether a Rule view projects a scalar PSG Rule or a PSG DecisionTable (Hotfix 065).

ScalarValue.description: A JSON scalar: string, number (integers included) or boolean. The branches are disjoint.

Scenario.description:
A Scenario view (Hotfix 065). `given`, `when` and `then` are RFC 8785 canonical JSON texts of
the exact PSG values; `status` is the node ElementStatus and `confirmation_status` the
Scenario confirmation.

ScenarioPage.description:
A page of results; `next_cursor` is null on the last page. An item of the page whose
projection failed is in `health` (with its typed error) instead of `items`; corruption
is reported, never hidden, and the remaining items are still returned.

ScenarioStatus.description: The ElementStatus of a Scenario node.

kind.description: The exact retrieval document kind wire string.

path.description:
The exact detail route of the hit; `null` means there is no exact detail route for its
indexed family (Hotfix 065).

SearchPage.description: A page of results; `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

SemanticChangePreviewResponse.description:
A server-authoritative semantic change preview (Hotfix 073): the exact domain Proposal is
persisted as a pending workflow proposal bound to the baseline revision and nothing is
committed. `version`, `revision` and `semantic_hash` are the baseline; `events` is empty.
Confirmation is the existing proposal action on `proposal_id`.

SemanticElementDiff.description:
The semantic element effect of dry-applying one exact server-built domain Proposal to the
baseline graph (Hotfix 073). `candidate_semantic_hash` is the semantic hash of that candidate
graph only: it is not a revision identity and not a prediction of the committed
`semantic_hash`, because acceptance governance (the proposal-acceptance ResolutionDecision)
may change it. The ID lists hold only semantic-hash-participating nodes and edges, each
unique and sorted ascending.

Sentence.description: A compatibility view of exactly one Requirement (there is no Sentence node type).

SentenceEditRequest.description: The edited typed slots of a sentence.

SentencePage.description: A page of results; `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

SentenceSlotPatch.description: The supplied slot changes of a Sentence edit; at least one is required at runtime.

SentenceSlots.description:
The typed slots of a Sentence: the exact requirement_kind, level and modality wire values
of its Requirement (Hotfix 065).

kind.description:
The authoritative workflow class of the proposal (Hotfix 077): the one positive proposal
action endpoint that can confirm it.

SessionStage.description: The active compiler stage of a session turn, exactly `plumb_core::StageId` (Hotfix 065).

Span.description: One evidence span of a source.

SpanPage.description: A page of results; `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

WriteResult.description: The result of a successful write. `version` is the compatibility alias of `revision`.

info.description: Plumb pilot HTTP API contract (A0.1): a task-oriented compatibility projection over the PSG. Runtime handlers are provided by A0.2, A0.3 and A0.4 (operations 1-72) and U2.1 (the two semantic change previews, operations 73-74).

x-plumb-error-codes.meaning: The operation needs runtime material that is not configured.
The assumption is not in an active lifecycle state.
The attribute already has the requested classification.
An automatically accepted stage proposal would need a human reason.
The calculation cannot be evaluated for the given inputs.
The calculation's input scope is not available on the current head.
The calculation result cannot be represented on the wire.
The cursor was issued at another branch-head revision or semantic hash.
The cursor is malformed or not canonical.
The cursor belongs to another request.
A stored decision table encoding is invalid.
The decision table is not valid for this operation.
The revision has no parent to diff against.
An expression exceeds a resource limit.
A required external validator is not available.
The finding's material no longer matches the current report.
The finding is not in the current gate report.
The finding does not affect this requirement.
Configured gate inputs are missing.
Gate inputs are stale for the current head.
A persisted gate report contradicts the current head.
No current gate report exists and none can be evaluated.
A derived stable ID already names another element.
The inference provider or its output inspection failed.
The operation requires inference and the null provider is configured.
A session needs an inference provider and the null provider is configured.
Intake requires a non-blank reason for this change.
Unexpected internal failure; details name the failing subsystem only.
Malformed path, query, header, body or multipart input.
A recipe job was interrupted by a process restart.
The Mermaid process text is malformed.
The process cannot be represented as linear Mermaid.
The route exists but does not accept this HTTP method.
The requested change would not change the model.
The decision table has no confirmable derived scenarios.
No open questions are available for the round.
No scenario in the scope can be run.
The addressed element does not exist.
The proposed change cannot be applied to the current graph.
The request body exceeds the route's size limit.
If-Match does not name the current branch-head revision.
The imported process conflicts with existing elements.
The process step change is invalid.
The process is not linear.
The process step still has relations.
The proposal's action cannot be classified unambiguously.
The requested action is not the proposal's classified action.
The proposal's baseline revision is no longer the head.
The intake evidence does not match the proposal.
The proposal is not pending.
The proposals of the set are not compatible on their shared base.
Question generation produced invalid output.
Question generation reported issues.
A persisted question cannot be projected.
The question round cannot be composed.
A persisted round contradicts its questions.
The round stakeholder is not valid.
No API route has this path.
The rule is not a decision table.
The scenario cannot be confirmed in its lifecycle state.
The scenario cannot be run in its lifecycle state.
A persisted scenario cannot be projected.
The stable scenario run ID holds another element.
A scenario run trace artifact is invalid.
A scenario run trace artifact is missing.
A scenario run trace link is invalid.
A scenario run trace does not match its run.
The scenario's lifecycle state does not allow the operation.
A domain service rejected the change or the target is in the wrong lifecycle state.
The session belongs to another user.
A turn of the session is still in flight; nothing was written.
A different source with this identity already exists.
The uploaded file yields no evidence fragments; nothing was written.
This exact source already exists.
A child stage of the recipe failed.
The stage output could not be committed.
The recipe needs configuration that is absent.
A phase or gate cannot be evaluated; details.error names the typed error.
A stage produced incompatible output kinds.
A phase cannot be planned; details.error names the typed error.
Stage proposals conflict with each other.
The recipe scope is invalid.
The edit would change the term's identity.
The terms cannot be merged.
The assumption default cannot be represented on the wire.
The request or source media type is not supported.
Persisted workflow state is impossible or corrupt.
